claim: Tucker and Spear's abstract-level report of a cross-sectional study across six U.S. hospitals identifies medications, orders, supplies, staffing, and equipment among the most frequent categories of hospital nursing work-system failures. This is structural evidence that supply and equipment failures occur in hospital nursing work. The source is not ED-specific and does not establish an ED supply-retrieval episode rate, origin/destination, search or travel duration, item availability process, retrieval success, or a reusable trip matrix. Those fields remain unknown; no frequency, distribution, policy, or model default is inferred.

primary_source.revision: PMID 16686887 / PMCID PMC1713207; captured NCBI EFetch XML response containing bibliographic metadata and structured abstract (6,883 bytes); full article text not present in the captured response
primary_source.population: General hospital nursing; six U.S. hospitals, minute-by-minute activity observations of 11 nurses, interviews with six nurses, and surveys in 48 nursing units. The source does not identify the sample as ED nursing.
primary_source.period: Cross-sectional study; observation dates are not stated in the captured structured abstract.
primary_source.units: Categorical work-system failure types. The abstract reports a per-eight-hour-shift failure frequency, but no numeric frequency is used in this record.
primary_source.licence_access: Captured through official NCBI E-utilities as bibliographic metadata and structured abstract. Licence terms for reuse are not established by this capture; no licence is inferred.

transformation.description: Recomputed SHA-256 of the bound XML and inspected its article metadata and structured Abstract > Principal Findings. Retained only the categorical supply/equipment failure evidence and study-scope limits; omitted all frequencies and made no parameter transformation.
transformation.input_units: NCBI EFetch XML metadata and structured abstract
transformation.output_units: Descriptive structural evidence; no numeric parameter

report_lineage.section: Resumption and switching overhead; Tucker and Spear supply/equipment failure sentence
